youtube.title: Swiss Cheese ke holes gayab kyun ho rahe hain? 🧀 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Swiss cheese ke holes dheere dheere kam ho rahe hain, aur scientists ne iski wajah dhoondh nikali. Pehle sab kehte the ki holes cheese ke andar maujood bacteria ki gas se bante hain. Ye aadhi sach baat hai.

2000 ke dashak mein Swiss researchers ne dekha ki holes kam ho rahe hain. Jaanch mein ek missing piece mila: hay, yaani sukhi ghaas. Purane zamaane mein gaay khuli barn mein dui jaati thi aur ghaas ke chhote kan doodh mein gir jaate the. Aaj ki milking machines itni saaf hain ki ghaas bachi hi nahi. Thoda sa hay powder wapas daalo, to holes laut aate hain.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
